blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Ninoy Aquino Stadium will play host to the opener of the 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup semifinals on Dec. 4, with Mall of Asia Arena, Ynares Center in Antipolo and Smart Araneta Coliseum serving as other venues. Barangay Ginebra and TNT open hostilities at 5:15 p.m. before NLEX and Converge square off at 7:30 p.m. at one of the league’s regular venues. It will be the only playdate inside one of the facilities at Rizal Memorial Sports Complex in Manila, and presumably the last for the season.
